protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Oral small molecule, not a peptide. Trial arms used once-daily doses with 4-week escalation intervals (3, 12, 36 mg). The page states Foundayo became FDA-approved in 2026, but research-grade material is not the approved product; no reconstitution.

schedule.description: Oral once daily, with 4-week escalation intervals in trials.

regimen.notes: Trial dose arms are distinct from a prescription for research-grade material. The source notes an approved product, but research material is not that product.
